raw_need: Release QIF v0.7.1 Outcome Collection Ledger
validated_need: Provide an append-only, domain-general outcome observation ledger that preserves historical revisions, late-arrival status, source corrections, custody transitions, and current-snapshot alignment without mutating prospective enrollment or claiming evidence truth
decision_summary: Visionary frames temporal evidence integrity as the next empirical-calibration boundary; Builder can extend calibration-report locally; Guardian requires immutable history, explicit correction lineage, custody sequencing, current-snapshot reproduction, and governance without truth or authority claims.

validation_questions_answered.question: What is in scope?
validation_questions_answered.answer: calibration-report schema, verifier, example, fixtures, docs, portable package, and release; no external collection or operational decisions

validation_questions_answered.question: How is success judged?
validation_questions_answered.answer: append-only history and custody are reproducible while example-only evidence remains non-empirical

hidden_assumptions: a corrected record can safely replace the record originally observed
the latest source value is necessarily the true value
evidence_gaps: no independently verified operational ledger entries are committed, so outcome truth and custody authenticity remain unestablished
